newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UIS says regional currency woes damaging.
newsitem.headline: UIS says regional currency woes damaging.

text.p: United International Securities Ltd (UIS) said on Tuesday its immediate prospects had been hampered by the recent hit on regional currency markets.
"Near term prospects appear clouded by the recent weakness of the southeast Asian currency markets precipitated by the de facto devaluation of the Thai Baht," UIS said in a statement.
But it said regional markets had become more attractive in relation to other emerging markets in Latin America and Eastern Europe.
"When concerns over currency stability ease, as we expect them to, funds are likely to return to the region," UIS said in a statement accompanying its interim results for the year to June 30.

UIS, a unit of United Overseas Bank Ltd which saw net profits rise 37 percent to Singapore $6.80 million against S$4.95 million previously, intended "to take advantage of this likely change in sentiments" when it occurred.
